plan.h: Why the lip-sync kept failing (found and fixed)
items: The Den's mix script dropped the silence before the first line, so every voice in rough cuts 1 to 3 played 0.35 s early against the picture. I proved it by matching each take against the voice track: all nine lines were 0.35 s early. Fixed with a silent bed from 0; every line now lands within 7 ms of its plan.
This page also played every voice two frames (0.08 s) early: the full-quality stream's picture started at 0.083 s. Fixed in the page builder for every timeline page from now on.
No pollution: the talking prompts carry only The Den's own words (same-prompt check).
The three "I'm out"s and "good feeling" measure in sync; the nurse's voice sits 0.08 s behind her mouth phrase by phrase.
Music: your pick (piano and clock, take 1), ducked under the voices and faded at the end.
End card: the National Audit Office finding.

The minister's pitch: his clip says "Every teenager in the country" faster than the voice, then grins while the voice finishes, and turns his head away for a moment. The fix is a re-shoot as two shorter talking clips (a Flow video round): say go.
Trim toward ~20 s: which beats or lines go?
